coverage_gaps.suggested_test_intent: Register a yfinance tool for data_collector and verify it is called when collecting stock data.
Register a multi-source data integration tool (e.g., yfinance, alpha_vantage) for enterprise_data_collector and verify it is called for data collection.
Register a quantitative analysis tool (e.g., factor model, portfolio optimizer) for enterprise_quantitative_analyst and verify it is called for quantitative analysis tasks.
Register a risk analysis tool (e.g., VaR calculator, stress tester) for enterprise_risk_analyst and verify it is called for risk assessment tasks.
Register a portfolio optimization tool for enterprise_portfolio_manager and verify it is called for portfolio management tasks.
Register a financial analysis tool (e.g., ratio calculator, DCF model) for enterprise_financial_analyst and verify it is called for financial analysis tasks.
Register a compliance checking tool for enterprise_compliance_officer and verify it is called for compliance tasks.
Register a report generation tool (e.g., PDF/HTML formatter) for report_generator and verify it is called for report generation tasks.

new_test_requests.objective: Verify that data_collector can use a registered yfinance tool to collect stock data.
new_test_requests.input: Collect historical price data for AAPL from Yahoo Finance.

metadata.note: Requires registering a yfinance tool for data_collector before execution.

new_test_requests.objective: Verify that enterprise_quantitative_analyst can use a registered factor model tool for quantitative analysis.
new_test_requests.input: Perform a factor analysis on AAPL using the Fama-French three-factor model.

metadata.note: Requires registering a factor model tool for enterprise_quantitative_analyst before execution.
